tasks.name: mapWithContext
tasks.request: Add mapWithContext<T,C,R>(createContext:()=>C, project:(value:T,context:C,index:number)=>R):OperatorFunction<T,R>. Allocate exactly one context for each subscription, including empty subscriptions, before subscribing upstream. Keep context and zero-based indices separate across subscribers, and advance the index before calling project so reentry cannot reuse it. Emit each projection. Forward factory/project/source errors, stop synchronous producers after errors/unsubscription, and preserve normal teardown. Export from both public barrels and add meaningful src/*.test.ts tests.

tasks.name: takeThrough
tasks.request: Add takeThrough<T>(predicate:(value:T,index:number)=>boolean):MonoTypeOperatorFunction<T>. Forward values up to and including the first value for which predicate is false, then complete and unsubscribe upstream synchronously. Index starts at zero per subscription. Empty input completes without invoking predicate. A throwing predicate errors without emitting the offending value; upstream errors and early downstream unsubscription retain normal behavior. Export from both public barrels and add meaningful src/*.test.ts tests.

tasks.name: createQuota
tasks.request: Fix the existing compiler error, then add createQuota(limit:number) in src/quota.ts and export it from src/index.ts. Return an object with a read-only remaining getter, tryTake(amount=1):boolean and restore(amount=1):number. Limit and amounts must be nonnegative safe integers (RangeError otherwise). Taking too much returns false without mutation; zero is a no-op. Restore returns the new remaining amount capped at limit. State is independent per instance and invalid operations do not mutate it. Add meaningful src/*.test.ts tests.
